answer_1.quote: In this work, we explore the use of large language models to generate guiding sub-questions for math word problems.
answer_1.outputs: Socratic questions (sub-questions for math word problems)

answer_2.quote: We illustrate the benefit of our RL-based generation strategy using both automatic and human evaluation metrics.

answer_4.quote: For this analysis, we divided the questions among 4 annotators with an overlap of 40% of the questions among them to evaluate the generated question quality on the following factors.
answer_4.guideline: A 5-point Likert scale ranging from 1 (poor) to 5 (very good) was used for each dimension of quality assessment.
